scope: Owner-requested AlphaFold comparison; does not alter frozen ESM/Boltz plans
model: AlphaFold2 pTM via ColabFold 1.6.3 / alphafold-colabfold 2.3.20; all five pretrained parameter sets
reference: UniProt O60566 residues 721-1044, same checked sequences as Boltz
msa: Previously retrieved public-WT-derived 623-record shared alignment; no further alignment service query
metrics: within-model WT-versus-substitution CA RMSD and local RMSD
interpretation: Parameter sets/seeds are correlated sensitivity comparisons; neither structure resemblance nor confidence validates protein abundance, stability, pathogenicity or functional rescue. Agreement with Boltz may share evolutionary/training information. Retain all five models and all seeds, not just ranked winners.
candidate_reading: Prespecified diagnostic comparison; failed control sensitivity cannot establish a benign or damaging candidate. No drug ranking/phase/exposure claim.
